items.q: I have a great video idea, but I'm not sure how to get started. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. Share your idea and footage, and we'll talk through the structure, pacing, and style before editing begins.

items.q: How can editing make my video more engaging?
items.a: Good editing shapes pacing, rhythm, and transitions so the viewer stays with the story from the first second.

items.q: Do you offer any special effects or motion graphics?
items.a: Yes. Transitions, effects, and motion design can be added to suit your brand and platform.

items.q: What if I need edits for different platforms (YouTube vs. Instagram)?
items.a: Yes. Edits can be adapted for different aspect ratios, lengths, and platform conventions.

items.q: How can I make my video rank higher in search results?
items.a: Edits can be planned with search in mind, including hooks, chapter structure, and thumbnail-friendly moments.

items.q: How much creative control do I have over the editing process?
items.a: You stay involved at each stage, with feedback rounds built into the process so the final cut matches your vision.

items.q: Ready to get started? How can I contact you?
items.a: Message me on WhatsApp or email, and we can start with a free discovery chat.
